Mechanism fully verifiable from the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `refreshAccessToken` now does `const res = await refreshOAuthTokens(...); const token = res?.data;` and then reads `token.access_token`. But `refreshOAuthTokens` returns a native `fetch(...)` `Response` object when sharing is enabled (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId`), and a `Response` has no `.data` property. That makes `token` undefined and `token.access_token` will throw at runtime when sharing mode is on, matching the reported crash.
